prerequisite: Join an affiliated club as a member before applying for a licence.
track_rule: Must hold a current KA-issued or recognised Drivers Licence to drive on a KA-licensed track.
under_18: Participant’s Licence holder (parent/guardian) required; accompanies Driver when addressed by Officials.
p_plate: D Grade and 8-Day must display P plate at all times.
ods: Observed Driving Session required before first Meeting for D / 8-Day (and E where listed).
endorsements: Meeting endorsements via KOMP; apply to State Secretary to upgrade.

junior.min_age: 11th birthday (class restrictions — KA2 / Junior Max / Junior Performance from 12th)
junior.upgrade_c_to_b: 6 Meetings or top-5 National Championship/Series Junior

senior.min_age: 15th birthday (new); 14th birthday if moving up from Junior

tag_restricted_progression_2026: Updated TaG Restricted licence progression in 2026 NCR — C Grade cap at State Championship+; 40+ may hold A/B.

d_grade_higher_events.VIC_SA: Cadet/Junior D Grade need at least 2 D-to-C endorsements before Zonal / State Series / Cup / Trophy
